newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Kingsgate kicks up on upgrade talk.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Kingsgate kicks up on upgrade talk.

text.p: Shares in mineral explorer Kingsgate Consolidated NL kicked higher on Monday on speculation of a resource upgrade at its Chatree gold prospect in Thailand.
By 3.30 p.m. (0430 GMT), Kingsgate shares were 35 cents higher at A$3.15.

"There are rumours of a big upgrade at their Thai gold mine after some sensational results earlier in the year," said a dealer at a Perth-based brokerage, noting that the paucity of stock on issue made any moves very pronounced.
Kingstream has only about 31.2 million shares on issue.

On February 12, Kingstream said it had encountered encouraging gold mineralisation at its Chatree project with a best result from Prospect C of 13.19 grammes per tonne (g/t) at 42 metres. It said the weighted average mineralisation of the main mineralised structure in all holes was between 10.11 g/t and 46.6 g/t over a greater than 20 metre true thickness.

Since closing at A$1.12 on February 11, Kingstream shares have jumped nearly threefold to its record high of A$3.223 on March 3 while since December 31, 1996, the stock has leapt from 62 cents to current heady levels.
By 3.55 p.m. (0455 GMT), Kingstream shares were 33 cents higher at A$3.13 on turnover of 127,151 shares.
